title: People Technology Staff Product Manager
description:
**Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human**  

  

Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real\-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence.  

  

This is an opportunity to do career\-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk.

### **The Enterprise Technology Team**



The Enterprise Technology team builds and delivers the secure, scalable systems that power how our business runs. Our People Technology Team sits at the heart of this work, overseeing the full Hire\-to\-Retire technical ecosystem—including core applications like Workday, Greenhouse, and Cornerstone—and ensuring these platforms evolve alongside the company's growth. We partner closely with HR, Talent Acquisition, Talent Management, and Business Operations to bring data\-driven, compliant, and innovative solutions to life.


### **The Opportunity**



Reporting to the Director of People Technology, this role will serve as the Product Manager for Okta's People Technology portfolio, focused on Employee Growth \& Talent. You will act as the strategic bridge between global People leaders and delivery teams. You will translate strategic product visions into high\-velocity execution — shaping the what and why in partnership with Digital Solutions and People leadership, and partnering with the Delivery Lead on the how and when — while navigating complex enterprise workflows across Talent Acquisition (Greenhouse), Learning \& Development (Cornerstone), Talent Management (Workday), and AI\-driven automation.


### **What You'll Do**


* **Product Strategy \& Roadmap Leadership:** Define the multi\-year product vision and strategy for the Growth \& Talent domain in close collaboration with functional and technical leadership. Translate that strategy into a prioritized, outcome\-driven roadmap that articulates clear business value, return on investment (ROI), and measurable impact on talent operations and employee experience.
* **Talent Ecosystem Modernization:** Build data\-driven business cases and functional strategies for major platform initiatives across the talent ecosystem (e.g., ATS, LMS, and custom Workday Extend applications), articulating clear ROI, operational efficiency gains, and improved employee and candidate experiences.
* **Delivery Lead Partnership:** Partner closely with the Growth \& Talent Delivery Lead to translate business priorities and functional requirements into well\-scoped epics and user stories, while maintaining clear alignment on trade\-offs, velocity, and delivery milestones.
* **Functional \& Technical Alignment:** Act as the voice of the business and end users within technical discussions, translating complex functional requirements into clear product specifications and acceptance criteria. Partner with the delivery team to evaluate technical trade\-offs, balancing user experience, operational risk, and long\-term scalability.
* **AI \& Talent Automation Strategy:** Define the strategy and functional requirements for integrating AI across the talent lifecycle (sourcing, onboarding, learning, internal mobility)—evaluating build vs. buy solutions, designing human\-in\-the\-loop workflows, and ensuring enterprise\-grade privacy and ethical AI standards.
* **Global Stakeholder Management:** Drive cross\-functional alignment across Digital Solutions, distributed executive stakeholders, business functional leads, and US\-based product counterparts to ensure clear visibility, smooth change management, and high program adoption.

### **What You Bring to Okta**


* 8\+ years of Product Management experience leading internal enterprise platforms, enterprise HR/Talent systems, or complex B2B SaaS products at global scale.
* **Deep Talent Tech Domain Expertise:** In\-depth understanding of core Talent Acquisition, Learning \& Development, and Performance/Talent Management processes, with hands\-on familiarity with enterprise platforms such as Greenhouse, Cornerstone, and Workday Talent (or equivalent ATS/LMS/HCM ecosystems).
* **Strategic Business Case \& ROI Sizing:** Proven ability to translate long\-term business goals into multi\-year product strategies, build data\-backed investment cases, and measure the tangible ROI and operational impact of platform initiatives.
* **Technical Fluency \& Cross\-Functional Translation:** Demonstrated track record partnering with delivery teams on system integrations, data flows, and technical trade\-offs—translating complex business requirements into clear functional specifications, acceptance criteria, and PRDs.
* **AI \& Automation Acumen:** Functional understanding of enterprise AI applications, generative AI capabilities, and automated workflows, with an appreciation for human\-in\-the\-loop design, ethical AI, and data privacy safeguards.
* **Autonomous Global Leadership:** Proven success operating with high autonomy across distributed time zones (US / APAC / EMEA), driving alignment and influencing senior business stakeholders and technical delivery teams asynchronously.
* **Education:** Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Business, or equivalent practical experience.

#### **Preferred Qualifications**


* Experience scoping and delivering solutions on enterprise platform extensibility frameworks (e.g., Workday Extend, orchestration engines, or custom application ecosystems).
* Direct experience conceptualizing, testing, or deploying agentic AI workflows, conversational interfaces, or autonomous task automation in an enterprise HR context.
* Working knowledge of enterprise data governance, compliance standards (SOX, SOC2, GDPR), and sensitive employee data handling.

title: Product Manager I
description:
**About the Team**

Product Management in Meesho closely resembles our rocketship growth. Because we obsess over understanding customer behaviour, we’ve been able to carve out an e\-commerce niche in Tier 2/3/4 towns in Bharat. Our business growth is testimony to a singular focus on how we think of ‘product’ for our unique customers \- ones that have barely shopped online, but are now able to because of Meesho.

Fun fact: Nearly 7% of India’s households shop with us.
We are driven by a ‘user\-first’ mindset. We have a strong bias for action. Above all, our team is driven by impact, not features. We drive ‘problem discovery’ \& delivery \- not only obsess over “what to build”, but execute with rigour to create impact.

But there’s more – we love to have fun as much as we love to work hard. From movie buffs to sportspersons, we have a super cool team. So, if a game of badminton after a day of brainstorming at work sounds like something you would love to do, then join us!

**About the Role**

We are looking for a Product Manager I who is passionate about solving high\-impact problems in a fast\-paced start\-up environment with a high degree of autonomy. This is inherently a cross\-functional leadership role where you will work closely with teams such as software engineering, UX design, category management, marketing, operations, finance, etc. to bring a new product to life.
### **What you will do**

* Analysis, customer interviews, user research, competition analysis and other qualitative/quantitative techniques.
* Problem Identification \& Prioritization: Adopt a structured approach to identify what problems need to be solved and break them down into smaller chunks. Prioritize what problems need to be solved now vs. later.
* Solution Discovery: Facilitate a process to come up with the best technology\-led ideas to solve the prioritised problems. Harness the creativity of not just yourself but of other teams such as design, engineering., business, etc Be willing to experiment with multiple solution ideas and test them using MVPs, prototypes, etc.
* Product Delivery: Define detailed product requirements and work collaboratively with a cross\-functional team (design, engg. business, analytics, etc.) to bring a product to life. Ensure high product quality through processes such as user acceptance testing, dogfooding, etc.
* Go\-to\-Market Planning: Create a go\-to\-market plan working with business/marketing stakeholders to maximize product adoption and success.
* Adoption \& Metrics: Define product metrics for your area, and track them continuously. Identify usage patterns and come up with action plans to move metrics in the right direction.
* Roadmap Creation: Create a product roadmap for your area that has at least a 3\-month forward\-looking view of key customer/business problems to be solved.
### **What you will need**

* Overall experience of 3\+ yrs with at least 1\+ yrs in product management in a tech\-led company (consumer internet space is preferred).
* Exceptional problem\-solving skills based on first principles of thinking.
* Good understanding of technology, and comfort with product management processes such as A/B experimentation, writing product requirement documents, managing product backlogs, and creating roadmaps.
* Good communication and stakeholder management skills to get work done across different functions and drive product development.

This is an opportunity to do career\-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk.

**Senior Product Manager, Data Platform (India)**


**Company Overview**



Okta is The World’s Identity Company. We free everyone to safely use any technology—anywhere, on any device, for any app. Our Workforce and Customer Identity Clouds enable secure yet flexible access, authentication, and automation that transforms how people move through the digital world, putting Identity at the heart of business security and growth.


**Role Overview: Senior Product Manager, Data Platform**



As the Architect of Okta’s data\-driven future, the Senior Product Manager for Data Platform orchestrates the evolution of our core data infrastructure, pipelines, and analytics capabilities. This role manages the critical tension between high\-performance technical execution and the delivery of actionable business intelligence, translating high\-volume identity event streams into strategic outcomes. You will serve as the essential bridge between our India\-based engineering teams and a global suite of stakeholders, ensuring Okta's data remains a competitive differentiator and a cornerstone of trust for our customers.


**Key Responsibilities**


* **Orchestrate** the long\-term product vision and strategy for Okta’s data platform, ensuring infrastructure and analytics roadmaps align with the scale of the world’s identity traffic.
* **Architect** a robust API strategy and developer tooling framework to ensure data is seamlessly and securely consumed by services across the entire Okta ecosystem.
* **Collaborate** with India\-based engineering and development scrum teams to deliver high\-performance data pipeline enhancements and architectural improvements.
* **Distill** complex requirements from a diverse stakeholder group—including Product, Design, User Research, Marketing, Sales, and Go\-To\-Market teams—into precise technical specifications.
* **Analyze** large\-scale product data and identity\-centric orchestration logs to identify friction points and drive improvements in platform performance and user experience.
* **Validate** assumptions at low cost by building compelling hypotheses and designing rigorous experiments before committing to major infrastructure investments.
* **Track** industry trends in data engineering, AI/ML, and analytics to maintain Okta’s competitive edge and "never stop innovating."
* **Enable** internal counterparts by serving as the primary subject matter expert for data platform capabilities, fostering a culture of data\-driven decision\-making across the organization.

**Required Qualifications**


* **4\-5\+ years of Product Management experience** specifically within **enterprise\-scale SaaS platforms** or core software infrastructure.
* **BS in Computer Science, Computer Engineering**, or equivalent technical experience that enables you to rationalize and influence complex architectural decisions.
* **Proven ability to produce solid, actionable plans** from incomplete, conflicting, or highly ambiguous inputs.
* **Exceptional communication and presentation skills**, with a track record of successfully collaborating across global functions and time zones.
* Demonstrated business results from platform capabilities or products you have shipped at scale.

**Preferred Qualifications**


* Experience with data orchestration, low\-code/no\-code data tools, or Integration Platform as a Service (iPaaS).
* Deep familiarity with Identity and Access Management (IAM) protocols and security standards.
* Experience managing the API surface area and developer experiences for enterprise\-grade platforms.
* Advanced degree in a technical or business field (e.g., MS in a technical discipline or an MBA)

title: CDP - Technical Product Manager
description:
**About Tekion:**
-----------------


Positively disrupting an industry that has not seen any innovation in over 50 years, Tekion has challenged the paradigm with the first and fastest cloud\-native automotive platform that includes the revolutionary Automotive Retail Cloud (ARC) for retailers, Automotive Enterprise Cloud (AEC) for manufacturers and other large automotive enterprises and Automotive Partner Cloud (APC) for technology and industry partners. Tekion connects the entire spectrum of the automotive retail ecosystem through one seamless platform. The transformative platform uses cutting\-edge technology, big data, machine learning, and AI to seamlessly bring together OEMs, retailers/dealers and consumers. With its highly configurable integration and greater customer engagement capabilities, Tekion is enabling the best automotive retail experiences ever. Tekion employs close to 3,000 people across North America, Asia and Europe.

  

  

**Key Responsibilities:**


* CDP Roadmap \& Vision: Define and execute the product vision, strategy, and


roadmap for our CDP, aligned to company goals and customer needs.


* Stakeholder Alignment: Partner with Engineering, Data Science, Sales, Customer


Success, and external partners to ensure alignment and effective delivery.


* Voice of the Customer: Deeply understand user personas (dealers/OEMs), pain


points, data workflows, and market trends to inform product decisions.


* Product Design \& Requirements: Translate market/user insights into clear product


requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria for development teams.


* Data Governance \& Compliance: Ensure CDP meets security, privacy, and


regulatory (e.g., GDPR, CCPA) requirements.


* Performance Measurement: Define KPIs, monitor adoption, and iterate to deliver


measurable business and customer value.


* Go\-to\-Market: Collaborate in launch, enablement, and success of new features


with Marketing, Sales, and Support.


* Team Leadership: Mentor and guide associate/junior product managers.


Qualifications:


* Experience: 7\+ years in SaaS product management, with 3\+ years leading CDP,


CRM, or data infrastructure products (Automotive SaaS strongly preferred).


* Expertise: Deep understanding of CDP concepts: identity resolution, data


integration, segmentation, analytics, data privacy, API ecosystems.


* Technical Acumen: Adept at working with data teams (ETL, data lakes, cloud


platforms) and understanding technical tradeoffs.


* Domain Knowledge: Familiarity with automotive retail/OEM data flows, dealership


management systems (DMS) is a plus.


* Stakeholder Management: Proven track record interfacing with customers, sales,


and engineering teams.


* Communication: Exceptional communication, presentation, and documentation


skills.


Nice\-to\-Have:


* Experience with product\-led growth (PLG) models.


* Background in B2B enterprise SaaS platforms.


* Prior experience with scaling data products in regulated industries.


**Current Tekion Employees: Please apply via the Internal Job Board in** **Ashby**
